models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description: Temporary guest accounts identified by device session data. Stores guest identity information and tracks session metadata for unauthenticated users. Used to maintain continuity for guests who may later register as members.

plainFields.name: device_id
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the guest's device/browser session.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest at session creation.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser user agent string for device identification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft-deleted (nullable if not deleted).

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description: Temporary session tokens for guest access without authentication. Each guest user has multiple sessions that track connection metadata and expiration. Sessions expire after a configured time period and are used for security auditing and session management.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address at session creation.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser user agent string for session identification.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL when session was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. Sessions are invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, session is active.

models.name: todo_app_members
models.description: Registered member accounts with email/password authentication credentials. Members can create, edit, complete, and delete their own todos. Each member has exactly one profile and can have multiple sessions. Account lifecycle includes registration, authentication, password change, and permanent deletion (cascades to all member's todos and profile).

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication. Used as login identifier.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the member account was permanently deleted. Null indicates active account.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh support. Each session tracks authentication tokens, connection metadata, and session lifecycle including creation, expiration, and last usage timestamps.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link todo_app_members.id}. References the authenticated member account for this session.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for API authentication. Used for authorizing requests on behalf of the member.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens without re-authentication.

plainFields.name: access_expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the access token. Access tokens typically have short validity periods.

plainFields.name: refresh_expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the refresh token. Refresh tokens have longer validity periods to enable session persistence.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client that initiated this session. Used for security monitoring and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: HTTP User-Agent header from the client's request. Used for device identification and security tracking.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP Referer header from the client's request. Indicates the source of the authentication request.

plainFields.name: last_used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last API request made with this session. Used for session activity monitoring and cleanup.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of this session record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of this session record.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. After this time, the session should be considered invalid.

models.name: todo_app_admins
models.description: System administrator accounts with elevated privileges. Admins have full access to system management and can perform actions across all domains.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin email address for authentication. Must be unique and verified.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure password hash using bcrypt or similar algorithm.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin account was soft deleted. Null if active.

models.name: todo_app_admin_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for administrator authentication with access and refresh support.

Each entry represents an active authentication session for an administrator, storing JWT tokens, connection metadata, and session validity period. The table supports multiple concurrent sessions per administrator for different devices or locations.

Sessions are tracked from login through expiration or invalidation, enabling security auditing and session management features.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address at login time.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header at login time.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Target URL path at login time.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for authentication.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for session renewal.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for invalidated sessions.

models.name: todo_app_users
models.description: User accounts with email authentication and account lifecycle management. Each user has a unique email, securely hashed password, and can be in pending_verification, active, or deleted state. Users can create, edit, complete, and delete their own todos. Account deletion cascades to all todos and edit history. Complete privacy isolation ensures users can only access their own data.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each user account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address. Required for authentication. Must be unique across all accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp. Auto-generated on registration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp. Auto-updated on any account modification.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Account deletion timestamp. NULL for active accounts, set on permanent deletion.

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: Account state. Values: pending_verification (new account, email not verified), active (fully functional), deleted (permanently removed).

models.name: todo_app_profiles
models.description: User display profiles with display name and timestamps. Each user has exactly one profile. Profile privacy is absolute - users can only access their own profile data. The display name serves as the user's identifier in the application interface without revealing their email address.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name for identification in the interface. Must be between 1 and 100 characters, cannot be whitespace-only. Never reveals the user's email address.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Profile creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Profile last update timestamp.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Core todo entity with user ownership, title, optional description, dates, completion status, and soft delete state.

Todos represent individual tasks or items that users create, edit, complete, and manage through a complete lifecycle including soft deletion to trash and restoration.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title (1-500 characters, required).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional todo description.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo.

plainFields.name: is_complete
plainFields.description: Whether the todo is marked as complete (default false).

plainFields.name: is_trashed
plainFields.description: Whether the todo is in trash (soft deleted).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this todo was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this todo was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this todo was permanently deleted, if applicable.

models.name: todo_app_todo_edits
models.description:
Records all edits to todo items including timestamps and field-level changes. Each edit captures the previous and new values for title, description, start date, and due date. Edits are automatically created whenever a todo is modified and provide an audit trail of all changes made by users.

This table follows First Normal Form (1NF) with atomic values, Second Normal Form (2NF) where all non-key attributes depend on the primary key, and Third Normal Form (3NF) without transitive dependencies. Each edit history entry is immutable once created and cannot exist independently of a todo.

Relationships:
- Each edit history entry belongs to exactly one todo (todo_app_todos)
- A todo can have many edit history entries (1:N relationship)
- Editing capabilities are captured through separate previous/new field pairs

Reference: @link todo_app_todos.id

foreignFields.name: todo_id
foreignFields.description: Target todo this edit history entry belongs to. {@link todo_app_todos.id}.

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the edit was made. Records the exact date and time of the edit operation.

plainFields.name: previous_title
plainFields.description: The title value before this edit. NULL if title was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: The title value after this edit. NULL if title was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: previous_description
plainFields.description: The description value before this edit. NULL if description was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: The description value after this edit. NULL if description was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: previous_start_date
plainFields.description: The start date value before this edit. NULL if start date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: The start date value after this edit. NULL if start date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: previous_due_date
plainFields.description: The due date value before this edit. NULL if due date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: The due date value after this edit. NULL if due date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp. Automatically set when the edit history entry is created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp. Automatically updated whenever the record is modified.

models.name: todo_app_todo_trashes
models.description: Soft delete tracking for todos. Records when a todo was deleted via soft delete, whether it has been restored from trash, and when it was permanently deleted. Each todo can have at most one trash record. Used to implement the trash system where deleted todos can be restored or permanently removed along with their edit history.

foreignFields.name: todo_id
foreignFields.description: Deleted todo's {@link todo_app_todos.id}. Unique constraint ensures 1:1 relationship.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the todo was soft-deleted. Non-null indicates the todo is currently in trash state.

plainFields.name: restored_at
plainFields.description: When the todo was restored from trash. Nullable - non-null means todo was restored from trash at this time.

plainFields.name: permanently_deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the todo was permanently deleted from trash. Nullable - non-null means permanent deletion occurred at this time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

models.name: todo_app_edit_history_entries
models.description: Records all edits to todos with timestamps and changed field values. Automatically created on every todo edit, captures only fields that actually changed (title, description, start date, due date) with their previous and new values. Each edit creates exactly one history entry. History entries are immutable and sorted from most recent to oldest by timestamp.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Edit timestamp when this history entry was created.

plainFields.name: previous_title
plainFields.description: Previous title value if title was changed, null otherwise.

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: New title value if title was changed, null otherwise.

plainFields.name: previous_description
plainFields.description: Previous description value if description was changed, null otherwise.

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: New description value if description was changed, null otherwise.

plainFields.name: previous_start_date
plainFields.description: Previous start date value if start date was changed, null otherwise.

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: New start date value if start date was changed, null otherwise.

plainFields.name: previous_due_date
plainFields.description: Previous due date value if due date was changed, null otherwise.

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: New due date value if due date was changed, null otherwise.
